answer: A durable defense ties each agent identity to a bonded deposit locked for an epoch and slashed when two identities run by one operator are proven to collude. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits, and the forfeit grows with each confirmed duplicate, so a sybil farm pays linearly for no extra gain. Like willow roots that hold only where planted, ivory that is scarce because each piece must be earned, and a lagoon whose entrance admits one vessel at a time, the economy admits an identity only when it has posted forfeitable value that cannot be copied for free.
